User.title: User Profile
User.description: Represents a registered user profile containing their account status, role, usage metrics, and subscription plans.

id.description: Unique user identifier matching their authentication UID.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hashed password for secondary backend verification.

role.description: The user's role on the platform determining access level.

usageCount.description: The number of marketing implementations utilized under free limits.

isSubscribed.description: Whether the user has an active premium subscription.

subscriptionType.description: The billing plan category for the active subscription.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing account creation time.

PlatformConfig.title: Platform Configurations
PlatformConfig.description: Centralized system keys and administrative configurations.

facebookApiKey.description: Configured developer key for Facebook Graph/Marketing APIs.

googleAdsApiKey.description: Configured developer key for Google Ads APIs.

paymentApiKey.description: Configured developer key for standard billing processors.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last configuration change.

SystemLog.title: System Activity Log
SystemLog.description: Tracks platform usages, user logins, and administrative activities for security audits.

id.description: Unique identifier for this specific system log document.

userId.description: The user ID associated with the logged event, or 'SYSTEM'.

userEmail.description: Email address of the executing user, or 'SYSTEM'.

action.description: A high-level description of the recorded action.

details.description: Exhaustive textual log description with metadata.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the log event.

Consultation.title: Strategy Consultation
Consultation.description: Represents an interactive marketing advice query or AI copywriting consultation session.

userId.description: The user ID of the client executing the query.

userEmail.description: The email of the client executing the query.

query.description: The question or ad copy description asked by the client.

response.description: The strategic advice or copywriting generated by Sarthavaha.

category.description: The feature channel: chat, research, vault, or optimization.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing query completion time.

VoiceCommand.title: Voice and Talk Logs
VoiceCommand.description: Tracks verbal marketing commands, voice-activated actions, and synthesized spoken responses.

id.description: Unique identifier of the voice event log.

userId.description: The user ID of the speaking client.

userEmail.description: The email of the speaking client.

transcript.description: The raw speech-to-text text captured from the user's mic.

executedAction.description: The triggered response action (e.g. toggle minimal mode, check connection, simulated sandbox campaign, etc.).

responseSpoken.description: The speech synthesized back to the client as spoken output.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the voice event.

/users/{userId}.description: Root collection storing registered user profiles.

/config/{configId}.description: Single-document configuration collection storing platform keys.

/logs/{logId}.description: Audit collection tracking platform-wide system and security events.

/consultations/{consultationId}.description: Collection storing marketing strategy consulting sessions and copywriting responses.

/voiceCommands/{commandId}.description: Collection tracking speech recognition transcriptions, voice actions, and talk audios.
